purpose: Verify basis workflow BW-DEPT-01: stock request approved by HOD and issued by Dept_Admin.
preconditions: Inventory item exists with sufficient quantity. Faculty, HOD, Dept_Admin users exist.
action_or_input: Step 1: Faculty requests stock -> Step 2: HOD approves -> Step 3: Dept_Admin issues.
expected_result: Request transitions from None -> Pending HOD Approval -> Approved for Issuance -> Issued; inventory decremented; movement logged.

purpose: Verify basis workflow BW-DEPT-02: stock request rejected by HOD.
preconditions: Inventory item exists. Faculty and HOD users exist.
action_or_input: Step 1: Faculty requests stock -> Step 2: HOD rejects with remarks.
expected_result: Request transitions from None -> Pending HOD Approval -> Rejected; requesting faculty notified; terminal state.

purpose: Verify composite workflow CW-DEPT-01 path A: shared request progression through approved issuance.
action_or_input: Faculty requests quantity=4 -> HOD approves -> Dept_Admin issues.
expected_result: Terminal state Issued; final inventory is 6; audit movements logged for stock issuance.

purpose: Verify composite workflow CW-DEPT-01 path B: shared request progression ending in HOD rejection.
expected_result: Terminal state Rejected; inventory unchanged at 10; no issuance movement logged.

purpose: Verify basis workflow BW-DEPT-03: feedback submitted, reviewed by Dept_Admin, and closed by Dept_Admin.
preconditions: Student or Faculty authenticated. Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Step 1: User submits feedback -> Step 2: Dept_Admin reviews & categorizes -> Step 3: Dept_Admin closes simple issue.
expected_result: Feedback transitions from None -> New -> Under Review / Categorized -> Closed; submitter notified.

purpose: Verify basis workflow BW-DEPT-04: feedback submitted, reviewed by Dept_Admin, and resolved with HOD oversight.
preconditions: Student submits feedback. Dept_Admin and HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: Step 1: User submits feedback -> Step 2: Dept_Admin initial review -> Step 3: HOD oversight and resolution.
expected_result: Feedback transitions from None -> New -> Under Review / Categorized -> Resolved; submitter notified.

purpose: Verify composite workflow CW-DEPT-02 path 3A: Dept_Admin disposition after initial review.
preconditions: Student feedback submitted into New state.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin reviews, categorizes, and disposes as Resolved/Closed.
expected_result: Feedback reaches terminal Resolved/Closed state directly through Dept_Admin disposition.

purpose: Verify composite workflow CW-DEPT-02 path 3B: HOD oversight and disposition after Dept_Admin initial review.
preconditions: Feedback submitted and initial review completed by Dept_Admin.
action_or_input: HOD accesses oversight queue and applies terminal resolution.
expected_result: Feedback reaches terminal Resolved/Closed state through HOD oversight.

purpose: Verify basis workflow BW-DEPT-05: Dept_Admin proposes official department change, HOD approves, change becomes effective.
preconditions: Dept_Admin and HOD authenticated. Current department detail effective.
action_or_input: Step 1: Dept_Admin proposes official change -> Step 2: HOD approves official change.
expected_result: Change transitions from Current -> Pending HOD Approval -> Updated official data effective.

purpose: Verify basis workflow BW-DEPT-06: Dept_Admin proposes official department change, HOD rejects, current data retained.
preconditions: Dept_Admin and HOD authenticated. Current department detail effective.
action_or_input: Step 1: Dept_Admin proposes official change -> Step 2: HOD rejects official change.
expected_result: Change transitions from Current -> Pending HOD Approval -> Rejected; current department data retained.

purpose: Verify composite workflow CW-DEPT-03 path 2A: official department change lifecycle with approval.
expected_result: Updated official data becomes effective and published.

purpose: Verify composite workflow CW-DEPT-03 path 2B: official department change lifecycle with rejection.
expected_result: Proposal rejected and existing official department data retained.

purpose: Verify basis workflow BW-DEPT-07: HOD role reassignment and Headship synchronization.
preconditions: Current HOD assignment active. Institute Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Step 1: Institute Admin records HOD reassignment -> Step 2: System applies effective transition.
expected_result: Incoming HOD active; outgoing access revoked; incoming access granted; displayed Headship synchronized.

purpose: Verify basis workflow BW-DEPT-08: Dept_Admin role reassignment and access transition.
preconditions: Current Dept_Admin assignment active. Institute Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Step 1: Institute Admin records Dept_Admin reassignment -> Step 2: System applies effective transition.
expected_result: Incoming Dept_Admin active; outgoing access revoked; incoming access granted.

purpose: Verify composite workflow CW-DEPT-04 path 1A/2A: HOD reassignment lifecycle.
preconditions: Institute Admin records valid HOD reassignment.
action_or_input: Transition reaches effective time and executes.
expected_result: Incoming HOD activated, outgoing revoked, Headship synchronized to incoming HOD.

purpose: Verify composite workflow CW-DEPT-04 path 1B/2B: Dept_Admin reassignment lifecycle.
preconditions: Institute Admin records valid Dept_Admin reassignment.
action_or_input: Transition reaches effective time and executes.
expected_result: Incoming Dept_Admin activated, outgoing revoked, unique active Dept_Admin preserved.
